label: D1 after an a2 -> S1 rare transition (late episode), strongest after repeated rares
explanation: Fires only at D1. 99.9% of activations fall on D1 steps where the previous trial was a2 followed by a rare transition to S1 (prev_action==2 & prev_common==0 gives recall 0.88). It essentially never fires after a1 or after common transitions, and never at GO or D2. It is nearly confined to late episode (ep_trial >= 50, 99% of mass) and to low-value / a2-favoring policy states. It is most likely when the rare a2->S1 trial was rewarded or was itself preceded by another rare trial. Magnitude grows with runs of consecutive a2->S1 rare trials: requiring two rares in a row covers 73% of the top activation quartile but only 21% of the bottom one, and the top windows are 3-4 a2 S1R trials in a row. Precision is low (~0.28): most rare a2 trials late in the episode do not activate it, so the description is incomplete. Every variable in the predicate is observed by D1; the agent also sees d1 fixation errors as a weak extra correlate.
